task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice.
paragraphs: The volunteers are preparing a festival at the community center. Their tutor gives them active sentences about the preparations to change into passive sentences. {{red:The coordinator gives each volunteer a printed schedule every morning.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:The bakery sent the group two large boxes of bread yesterday.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:The art teacher is showing the children a new mural this morning.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:The mayor will give the center a special award at the opening.}} {{mask_4}} {{red:The center has offered Rosa a weekend job.}} {{mask_5}}

The class continues with more examples from the festival. {{red:The manager had given every family a map before the doors opened.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:A local shop gave the group some paint on Friday.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:Volunteers are bringing the children snacks this afternoon.}} {{mask_8}} {{red:The city will lend the center ten folding tables for the festival.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:The music teacher teaches new students two simple songs each week.}} {{mask_10}}

Next, the tutor introduces passive forms inside infinitive and gerund clauses. {{red:The organizers want someone to decorate the hall before Saturday.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:Mia hopes the volunteers will clean the garden after lunch.}} {{mask_12}} {{red:The children enjoy the librarian reading books aloud.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The coach wants someone to paint the team sign before the games.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:The visitors remember the guide showing them the old theater.}} {{mask_15}}

The final examples use passive voice inside subordinate clauses. {{red:Parents expect the cooks to serve lunch at noon.}} {{mask_16}} {{red:Everyone knows that the staff check the doors every evening.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:The committee announced that workers had repaired the roof.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:The manager says that someone is cleaning the kitchen now.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The volunteers believe they will finish the garden path by Friday.}} {{mask_20}} The tutor checks the answers, and the volunteers return to their festival preparations.

mask_1.target: Each volunteer is given a printed schedule by the coordinator every morning.
acceptable_variants: A printed schedule is given to each volunteer by the coordinator every morning.

mask_2.target: The group was sent two large boxes of bread by the bakery yesterday.
acceptable_variants: Two large boxes of bread were sent to the group by the bakery yesterday.

mask_3.target: The children are being shown a new mural by the art teacher this morning.
acceptable_variants: A new mural is being shown to the children by the art teacher this morning.

mask_4.target: The center will be given a special award by the mayor at the opening.
acceptable_variants: A special award will be given to the center by the mayor at the opening.

mask_5.target: Rosa has been offered a weekend job by the center.
acceptable_variants: A weekend job has been offered to Rosa by the center.

mask_6.target: Every family had been given a map by the manager before the doors opened.
acceptable_variants: A map had been given to every family by the manager before the doors opened.

mask_7.target: The group was given some paint by a local shop on Friday.
acceptable_variants: Some paint was given to the group by a local shop on Friday.

mask_8.target: The children are being brought snacks by the volunteers this afternoon.
acceptable_variants: Snacks are being brought to the children by the volunteers this afternoon.

mask_9.target: The center will be lent ten folding tables by the city for the festival.
acceptable_variants: Ten folding tables will be lent to the center by the city for the festival.

mask_10.target: New students are taught two simple songs by the music teacher each week.
acceptable_variants: Two simple songs are taught to new students by the music teacher each week.

mask_11.target: The organizers want the hall to be decorated before Saturday.

mask_12.target: Mia hopes the garden will be cleaned by the volunteers after lunch.
acceptable_variants: Mia hopes the garden will be cleaned after lunch.

mask_13.target: The children enjoy books being read aloud by the librarian.
acceptable_variants: The children enjoy books being read aloud.

mask_14.target: The coach wants the team sign to be painted before the games.

mask_15.target: The visitors remember being shown the old theater by the guide.
acceptable_variants: The visitors remember being shown the old theater.

mask_16.target: Parents expect lunch to be served by the cooks at noon.
acceptable_variants: Parents expect lunch to be served at noon.

mask_17.target: Everyone knows that the doors are checked by the staff every evening.
acceptable_variants: Everyone knows that the doors are checked every evening.

mask_18.target: The committee announced that the roof had been repaired by workers.
acceptable_variants: The committee announced that the roof had been repaired.

mask_19.target: The manager says that the kitchen is being cleaned now.

mask_20.target: The volunteers believe the garden path will be finished by Friday.
acceptable_variants: The volunteers believe that the garden path will be finished by Friday.
